text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are headed home<n>after some
bonus training and lunch<n>on a day off, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother! Look! They're holding an<n>apple fair!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister! Look! They're holding an<n>apple fair!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Apple jelly, apple tarts... Whoa! It all<n>looks so good!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I love them. They bring back a<n>precious
memory...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You see, I got lost once at a festival<n>once when I
was little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My mom found me pretty quickly, but<n>I couldn't
stop crying...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So she bought me a candy apple. And<n>when I took
a bite...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was so sweet that it made me feel<n>happy and
warm again... I stopped<n>crying right away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. So that's why I likes apples! I<n>feel warm
inside when I eat them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, they smell so nice. Thinking<n>about that time
again makes me want<n>to eat one...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... we probably shouldn't have<n>any now. We did
just eat lunch...
choice_data_list: We can come back when we're hungry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, you're right. We did just<n>eat...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I guess we could come back after<n>training
sometime...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I bet those apples will taste even<n>better on an
empty stomach...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We turn our backs to the pleasant<n>smell wafting
from the apple fair and<n>leave.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Room for dessert? You mean I can<n>have some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! Okay, I'll get a tart. And jelly.<n>And juice.
And...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, Rice Shower eats pretty<n>much everything
at the apple fair.
